# Regression/exercise test for the automap tile-reveal + fill renderer.
#
# TELEPORTs to every walkable tile (tile-type nibble != 0) in all of
# level 1 -- coordinates generated by directly reading DAT_002029cc's
# tile-type data, not guessed -- calling REVEAL after each so the
# ring-walk marks that tile revealed (TELEPORT and ordinary movement
# don't trigger the reveal ring-walk on their own; see memory.md's
# automap-reveal section). Then OPENMAP (the real change_game_mode(2)
# switch), a WAIT for the mode-1 entry handler to fire, and a
# screenshot.
#
# With DAT_00086bf0 (reconstructed), DAT_000842c0 (recovered), the
# sprite-blit pointer-truncation fixes, and OPENMAP going through the
# real mode switch, this now renders the full level-1 automap ON THE
# VISIBLE SCREEN: blue-filled rooms/corridors with dark wall edges,
# the ankh-shaped shrine, the branching central corridors -- matching
# the reference layout (minus doors and player annotations).
#
# Run:
#   UW_DATA_DIR="$(pwd)/data" UW_FAST_SLEEP=1 UW_DEMO_FILE=demos/demo_automap.txt \
#     UW_DEMO_DELAY_MS=3 ./build/uw_dbg
# then look at /tmp/demo_automap.bmp. ~4000 TELEPORT/REVEAL lines, so
# it takes ~1-2 min even fast-sleeped; that's expected.
